checked_claims.note: Poincaré duality correctly identifies the lowest-weight Borel-Moore homology of degree 16 with the lowest-weight ordinary cohomology of degree 26 and Tate twist 21.
The Casnati-Ekedahl degree calculations for the summands are correct.
Since the line bundle has negative degree on C, its global sections vanish as claimed.
A degree-zero line bundle on a curve has global sections if and only if it is trivial, which yields the stated isomorphism condition.
The identification of W_5 with the indicated bundle over the balanced tetragonal Hurwitz open is correct.

The evaluation-failure locus Z contains other components and lower-dimensional strata (such as unbalanced tetragonal curves and non-reduced support divisors) that are omitted from the geometry description.

The Gysin sequence for mixed Hodge structures is formulated assuming Z is a smooth variety, but Z is a singular/stratified substack. The lowest-weight Borel-Moore homology of Z is not isomorphic to that of the top stratum Z_top.
The complementary open U, where both CE obstructions vanish, has pure Tate lowest-weight cohomology.

The Hurwitz stack is finite étale over an open in M_0,18. Since finite étale covers of opens in M_0,n do not generally preserve the pure Tate property of cohomology (due to non-trivial braid group monodromy), the cohomology of the Hurwitz stack, and hence Z, contains non-Tate mixed Hodge structures.
Because of the gaps in CLM-Z-GEOMETRY, CLM-LOCALIZATION, and CLM-Z-TATE, the final Gysin assembly fails to prove that the exact target has only Tate summands.

finding_candidates.statement: Finite étale covers of opens in M_{0,n} (including Hurwitz stacks via the branch morphism) do not in general have pure Tate cohomology because non-trivial monodromy representations can introduce non-Tate mixed Hodge structures.

The evaluation-failure locus Z contains lower-dimensional strata of unbalanced tetragonal curves and non-reduced support divisors, which cannot be omitted from Gysin/localization sequences as they can contribute non-Tate classes.

proof_dependency_checks.note: The description of the evaluation-failure locus Z for the f_2=5 CE obstruction on the balanced tetragonal open is correct.
The stratification of the degree-six linear system by h^0 is correct.
The analysis of the components and dimensions of Z ignores the complement of the balanced open (unbalanced tetragonal curves) and treats the open top stratum as the entire closed locus Z.
The claim of pure Tate cohomology for the contribution supported on Z fails because the Hurwitz stack (a finite étale cover of an open in M_{0,18}) has non-Tate mixed Hodge structures.
Since the support contribution is not pure Tate, the Gysin assembly into the lowest-weight target fails.

strongest_attack: The strongest attack refutes CLM-Z-TATE by identifying a fundamental monodromy gap: the Hurwitz stack of tetragonal genus-6 curves is a finite étale cover of an open in M_{0,18}, but finite étale covers of pure Tate varieties do not in general have pure Tate cohomology. The non-trivial braid group action on the fiber of the cover produces local systems whose cohomology contains non-Tate mixed Hodge structures. Additionally, the Gysin sequence in CLM-LOCALIZATION is formulated assuming Z is a smooth variety of pure dimension, thereby omitting lower-dimensional strata and unbalanced tetragonal curves which can contribute non-Tate classes or obstruct extensions.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
